question: In December 1929, under the presidency of ______, the Lahore Congress formalised the demand of 'Purna Swaraj'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Lahore Congress** took place in** December 1929** and was presided over by **Jawaharlal Nehru.**
 
• During this congress, the demand for** 'Purna Swaraj' **or **complete independence for India** was formalized.
 
• **Baldev Singh** was a prominent **Sikh politician** who served as the** first Defence Minister** of India.
 
• **Jagjivan Ram** was a **Dalit leader **and freedom fighter who served as the **Deputy Prime Minister** of India.
 
• **Asaf Ali** was a **Muslim leader** and freedom fighter who served as the** Ambassador of India** to the United States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement and served as the** first Prime Minister of India** after independence.
 
• **Baldev Singh **played a key role in the** integration of princely states **into the Indian Union after independence.
 
• **Jagjivan Ram** was known for his efforts to **uplift the marginalized sections** of Indian society, particularly Dalits.
 
• **Asaf Ali **was a** lawyer and politician** who played an active role in the Indian independence movement and later served as the** Governor of Orissa**.
